post.title: Test Post: A Discussion About TypeScript Performance
post.author: testuser

comments.author: commenter1
comments.contentMarkdown: Great article! TypeScript's type system has really improved performance in the latest versions.

comments.author: commenter2
comments.contentMarkdown: I agree, but there are still edge cases where compilation is slow.

comments.author: testuser
comments.contentMarkdown: That's a fair point. We're working on incremental compilation improvements.

comments.author: commenter3
comments.contentMarkdown: Have you tried using project references? That helped our team significantly.

comments.author: commenter4
comments.contentMarkdown: The real bottleneck is usually not TypeScript itself but the build pipeline.

comments.author: commenter5
comments.contentMarkdown: Exactly! esbuild and swc have changed the game for us.

comments.author: testuser
comments.contentMarkdown: Thanks for the discussion everyone. We're looking into all these suggestions.

comments.author: commenter1
comments.contentMarkdown: Happy to help! Looking forward to the improvements.

comments.contentMarkdown: I've been using `ts-ignore` as a workaround for slow compilation. Not ideal but works.
